notifications.title: Your fort at (1, -2) held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten after 2 rounds.

notifications.title: A horde attacks your fort at (1, -2)
notifications.body: 9 against its 10 defenders.

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 6 rounds.

notifications.title: Achievement: Godslayer
notifications.body: Slay the Avatar of Černobog.

notifications.title: The Avatar of Černobog is slain
notifications.body: Its flesh falls to ash. Every village of the group gets 11200 resources.

notifications.title: Achievement: Palisade
notifications.body: Raise a fort in the field.

notifications.title: Fort at (1, -2) finished
notifications.body: Armies holding it fight from behind its walls.

notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-7, 9)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 2800 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 1 of them against its guard of 32.

notifications.title: A refuge by the Holy City
notifications.body: You's refuge takes in your people at (-1, 2).

notifications.title: Achievement: Ashes
notifications.body: Lose a village to a horde.

notifications.title: Ozerishche was razed
notifications.body: Only ruins are left. Rebuild them, or start over from what remains.

notifications.title: Dobrynya is wounded
notifications.body: Back on their feet in a few hours.

notifications.title: Ozerishche is being razed
notifications.body: The horde broke the defenders after 1 rounds and is burning the village.

notifications.title: Ozerishche is under attack
notifications.body: A horde of 1 is fighting your garrison of 0.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to Ozerishche
notifications.body: The severe north horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Achievement: The Black God Walks
notifications.body: See the Avatar of Černobog rise.

notifications.title: The Avatar of Černobog walks at (0, -1)
notifications.body: The ritual is done. The Black God takes flesh and marches on the villages. Slay it for a great bounty.

notifications.title: Spring has come
notifications.body: The thaw: the land wakes, and every front stirs alike.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (1, -1)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 2450 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (1, 5) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the south hates you the more for it: +40% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Winter has come
notifications.body: Snow on the fields: no grain at all, the stores must last. The Monsters of the North come twice as often.

notifications.title: Cultists of Černobog gather at (0, -1)
notifications.body: They work a dark ritual. Scatter them before it ends, for a bounty of at least 2100 resources; every soldier who falls fighting them brings its end nearer. If it ends, something terrible walks.

notifications.title: The captives at (-7, 8) were taken away
notifications.body: The next horde from the south hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Autumn has come
notifications.body: The harvest is in and the ground is firm: every soldier holds 20% better. The Order marches half as often again; the nomads go home to winter.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (1, 5)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 1750 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the south.

notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (-7, 8)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 1400 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (-4, 5).
